entries.title: Bring named secrets from JSON and unlock a source for one run
entries.body: Infinitary can bring just the named secrets from a JSON export without showing their values to your crew. If a trusted command needs a key you already keep in Secrets, the card names the key and program. Your computer asks you to confirm giving it to that program for this run only.

picture.alt: A Bring into Secrets card names the receiving program, one kept key and its receiving variable, and a checked login field. It shows no values.
